title: Auto Safety Complaints
description: NHTSA consumer complaints about vehicle safety defects
data_source: U.S. Department of Transportation, National Highway Traffic Safety Administration
disclaimer: Consumer complaints submitted to NHTSA. Not verified by NHTSA. Complaint counts alone do not indicate a safety defect. Higher-selling vehicles naturally receive more complaints. Not legal advice.
methodology: Complaints pre-aggregated by make/model/year. Component categories extracted from NHTSA's colon-separated hierarchy. Crash, fire, injury, and death flags are consumer-reported, not verified. Recall counts cross-referenced from NHTSA recall database.
